title: Roblox Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30, Roblox held USD 6.084 billion of cash and investments, USD 1.009 billion of long-term debt, and reported 716.767 million weighted-average basic shares for Q2.
summary: The unchanged Q2 filing confirms USD 2.911 billion of first-half revenue, a USD 433 million first-half net loss, USD 890 million of company-defined first-half free cash flow, substantial net cash, stock compensation and ongoing dilution, safety, regulatory and platform risks.
